value: A CLI command `cairn groundloop stop|start|restart|status` that composes with the existing flag-file mechanism and liveness record to give the operator control over the ground loop process.

value.text: Redesigned: the command is 'cairn cairn start' (shortcut 'cairn start'), not 'cairn groundloop'. It launches the ground loop, bus, and shims. The ground loop self-restarts on code change unless prohibited by a flag. No trouble-ticket capability in the ground loop — it is heartbeat + device list, that is all. Nobody else checking on it. Simplification of existing ground loop code to remove trouble-ticket machinery is pre-approved.
